description: This file defines the ErrorRule class, which extends AbstractRule and manages error handling logic related to endpoint resolution errors in the AWS SDK v2 endpoint ruleset. It evaluates specific conditions and throws exceptions when errors are encountered.

classes.name: ErrorRule
classes.description: Handles error evaluation within endpoint rules, raising exceptions when error conditions are met.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ErrorRule with a definition array and stores the error details.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the error information associated with this rule.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the rule's conditions; if met, throws an UnresolvedEndpointException with a resolved error message.
